subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

While I was walking to the store, my friend calls me and ask for a favour.

options.text: my friend calls me and ask

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins in the past tense ("While I was walking"), so the rest of the sentence should also be consistent in tense.
 
• The phrase "my friend calls me" should be in the past tense to match the first part of the sentence. It should be "my friend called me."
 
• Additionally, the verb "ask" should be in the past tense. It should be "asked."
 
• Thus, the correct phrase is "**my friend called me and asked**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"While I was walking to the store, my friend called me and asked for a favour."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "While I was walking"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **3: "to the store"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **4: "for a favour"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **2: "my friend calls me and ask"** – The error here is the incorrect use of present tense verbs "calls" and "ask" instead of the past tense "called" and "asked."
